motion.$description: Motion: Tailwind v4's default transition duration and its ease-out curve, which is what shadcn's own animations are timed against. All three durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (A11Y-11); that override is emitted into the generated CSS from the reducedMotion extension below, so the accessibility rule lives with the token rather than in a stylesheet someone has to remember.

dur-none.$description: No delay. Use where a staged motion variable needs an explicit zero-valued first entry.

dur-fast.$description: Tailwind's default transition duration. Hover, press, colour.

dur.$description: Enter/exit of an overlay — dialog, popover, toast.

dur-progress.$description: Finite pending-state progress and shimmer cadence. It is not for decorative idle motion.

dur-ambient.$description: Quiet ambient cadence for an interactive surface that must visibly remain discoverable while idle, such as nearby-device radar. Never use it for generic decoration.

scale-breathe-min.$description: Lower spatial bound for quiet ambient breathing on an interactive signal.

scale-breathe-max.$description: Upper spatial bound for quiet ambient breathing on an interactive signal.

scale-pulse-start.$description: Starting scale for an active radial scan pulse.

scale-pulse-end.$description: Ending scale for an active radial scan pulse.

ease.$description: Tailwind's `ease-out`. UI entrances and fades decelerate into place and never ease in.

ease-linear.$description: Constant spatial progress for radial reveals, where front-loaded movement hides the chosen origin.
